description: Helprism plugins for coding agents: keep your help center true when you ship.

plugins.name: helprism
plugins.description: Helprism sync (beta): after a code change, the helprism-sync skill decides whether any help article is now wrong or incomplete, drafts the rewrite, and sends it to Helprism for human review. Connects the hosted Helprism MCP server; sign in with your browser when asked.
